facts.text: Bruce, I came for the free food. Don't tell the others I took the last slice.
facts.why: Barry never says this. His real line about food is 'It causes me to burn a tremendous amount of calories. So I'm just a black hole of snacks.'
facts.fix: So I'm just a black hole of snacks.

fix_note.text: So I'm just a black hole of snacks.

facts.text: The team gathering at Bruce's lake house.
facts.why: No lake house appears. At the end Bruce and Diana set up the team's base, with Wayne Manor suggested as the place, and a search found no lake house either.
facts.fix: The team's new base, set up by Bruce and Diana.

vibe.verdict: A smart banquet with Alfred's penguins and 'I'm rich', but the hall is more generic than Gotham.
